theme.title: Courtside Curiosities
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Boston won 8 straight titles in the 1960s. After the Lakers' 2010 title, how many had coach Phil Jackson won in total?
questions.note: Six with Chicago and five with the Lakers; this one was also his first Finals Game 7 as a coach.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Lakers head coach Phil Jackson earned his 11th NBA championship title

funFacts.text: That championship was Phil Jackson's first Finals Game 7 as a head coach despite his long title-winning career.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: as well as head coach Phil Jackson’s first-ever Finals Game 7

funFacts.text: Boston was one victory from reclaiming the trophy when it traveled to Los Angeles for Game 6.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers returned to Los Angeles with a 3–2 deficit in the series

funFacts.text: Kobe Bryant was Finals MVP for a second consecutive year as the Lakers repeated as champions.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kobe Bryant was named the Most Valuable Player of the Finals for the second consecutive year

questions.prompt: The chart shows three elite regular seasons. How many games did the 1996–97 Bulls win, a year after going 72–10?
questions.note: The league's best record; injuries and a last-game Pippen miss ended their chase of 70.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: Joakim Noah averaged 10.4 rebounds as Chicago's center in 2010–11. What did Tim Duncan average in the 2013–14 title season, at 37?
questions.context: San Antonio · regular season · veteran center
questions.note: In fewer than 30 minutes a night, on a team where no one averaged 30.

funFacts.text: Duncan blocked 139 shots during the regular season.
He started all seventy-four games he played.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tim Duncan | C | 74 | 74

funFacts.text: Duncan scored 1,119 points during the season.

questions.prompt: How many seconds were left when Ray Allen hit his game-tying corner three in Game 6 of the 2013 Finals?
